name: cvgnome-desktop

scripts.engine:build: uv run --locked --project engine --group dev python scripts/build_engine.py
scripts.engine:test: uv run --locked --project engine --group dev python -m unittest discover -s engine/tests -v
scripts.native:lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run engine:test && npm run ui:test && npm run build && npm run engine:build && npm run native:check && npm run native:test && npm run contract:test && npm run contract:frozen
scripts.engine:smoke: uv run --locked --project engine --group dev python scripts/build_engine.py --smoke-test-only
scripts.contract:test: uv run --locked --project engine --group dev python scripts/check_native_engine_contract.py
scripts.contract:frozen: uv run --locked --project engine --group dev python scripts/check_frozen_contract.py

description: Free local career workspace for individual job seekers
